primitives.name: Scrimmage Initiation Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: The ball shall be put in play by a scrimmage unless otherwise specifically provided.
primitives.assumptions: Ball is placed at line of scrimmage; players must be in formation before snap.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When snapper-back violates pre-snap positioning or feints.

layer2.mapping: GSI's belief network models scrimmage legality as a binary event; GSE encodes this into a deterministic state transition graph.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of legal snap timing and player alignment.

primitives.name: Fair Catch Playback Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: After a fair catch the, ball may be put in play by any player of the side making the fair catch, by either a punt, drop-kick, place-kick or scrimmage.
primitives.assumptions: Player who catches the ball retains right to initiate next play.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a player attempts to play the ball without valid action.

layer2.mapping: GSE uses fair catch as a kernel to derive subsequent play options; GSI evaluates these as conditional probabilities over action space.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking of post-fair catch play selection and execution.

primitives.name: Penalty Enforcement Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: If a foul is declared the ball shall not be put in play again until the penalty therefor has either been enforced or declined.
primitives.assumptions: Enforcement or decline halts game progression until resolved.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon foul declaration without immediate resolution.

layer2.mapping: GSI models penalty resolution as a stochastic process; GSE treats it as a control input that modifies state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Time delay between foul and resumption of play.
